cards.card_text: Then Nehemiah says he, his brothers and his servants have been lending the people money and grain too, and he says, "Please, let us stop this usury." Not "you," friend.
cards.verse_text: Please, let us stop this usury.
cards.snippet: Please, let us stop this usury.

cards.card_text: Then there's a man who increases his wealth by interest and usury.
cards.verse_text: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.
cards.snippet: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.

cards.card_text: True or false: wealth piled up by interest and usury ends up laid up for one who is kind to the poor.
cards.verse_text: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.
cards.snippet: He who increases his wealth by interest and usury lays it up for one who is kind to the poor.

cards.card_text: Then the money comes in: usury, excess interest, extorting the neighbors.
cards.verse_text: You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors.
cards.snippet: You engage in usury, take excess interest, and extort your neighbors.
